ui:enumNames.zh: 开启 · 默认后台审核（只记录）

ui:enumNames.en: On · check first by default (refuse hits)
ui:enumNames.zh: 开启 · 默认先审后发（命中拒绝）

ui:help.zh: 没有名单条目的用户按这里处理。决定顺序：锁定为“总是先审”的用户 → 锁定为“只后台审核”的用户 → 观察名单级别 → 这里的默认处理。
ui:help.en: How users without a list entry are handled. Order: users locked as always-check-first → users locked as background-only → watch level → this default.

description.en: Whether a request is checked before it is sent on or in the background, and what happens when moderation fails. What is moderated and by which auditors is set on the flows.
description.zh: 决定请求先审后发还是后台审核，以及审核失败时怎么办。审什么、用哪些审核器在“审核流程”里配置。

ui:help.en: Covers auditor errors, the total timeout and overload (too much in progress). Background moderation always lets requests through.
ui:help.zh: 覆盖审核器出错、总超时和繁忙（处理中的请求超限）。后台审核总是放行。

ui:help.en: 403 by default; 400 or 451 are common alternatives.
Returned to the client when a request is refused (code moderation_blocked).
ui:help.zh: 请求被拒绝时返回给客户端的错误信息（错误码 moderation_blocked）。

ui:help.en: The first suspicious record adds the user at the default level.
ui:help.zh: 首次出现可疑记录时，以默认级别加入名单。

ui:help.en: Each new violation at the observe level extends it.
ui:help.zh: 观察级每次违规都会顺延。

ui:help.en: Violations within the window that put a user at the enforce level (counted like the ban threshold, from the last manual change of the user's entry; background-only and always-check-first users and moderation staff excluded; a ban reached by the same violations wins). A user not on the list is added at the enforce level. 0 disables it.
ui:help.zh: 窗口内违规达到该次数，用户自动升为拦截级（计数口径同封禁阈值，从该用户最近一次人工调整名单之后算；“只后台审核”“总是先审”名单用户和审核管理员除外；同时达到封禁阈值时只封禁）。不在名单上的用户直接以拦截级加入。0 表示关闭。

ui:help.en: Suspicious requests within the window that ban a user (false positives excluded). 0 disables automatic bans.
ui:help.zh: 窗口内达到该次数的可疑请求即自动封禁用户（不含误报）。0 表示不自动封禁。

ui:help.en: 0 bans until an administrator unblocks the user.
ui:help.zh: 0 表示直到管理员手动解封。

ui:help.en: Hits are always recorded.
ui:help.zh: 命中始终记录。

ui:help.en: Keep the moderated text, and the raw messages of the chunk the verdict came from when a stage hit. They may contain user data; error records keep only the start (see Text kept on error records).
ui:help.zh: 保存被审核的文本，以及有级命中时判定那一块的原始消息，可能包含用户数据；出错记录只保存开头（见“出错记录保存字数”）。

ui:details.en: Whatever is moderated is also sent to the moderation channels: choose channels whose data handling you accept.
ui:details.zh: 被审核的内容会发送给审核渠道，请选择数据处理方式可以接受的渠道。

ui:title.en: Raw messages of passed records too
ui:title.zh: 通过的记录也保存原始消息

ui:help.en: With Store moderated text on, passed and overturned records also keep the raw messages (images included) of the chunk the verdict came from, for later review; off, only records with a stage hit keep them. Error records never keep raw messages.
ui:help.zh: 保存原文开着时，通过和被推翻的记录也保存判定那一块的原始消息（含图片），便于事后复核；关闭后只有命中过的记录保存。出错的记录不保存原始消息。

ui:help.en: Concurrent background auditor calls per node (and background workers). Checking first has its own max(64, 4× this) slots.
ui:help.zh: 后台审核在每个节点同时进行的调用数，也是后台工作协程数。先审另有 max(64, 4×此值) 个名额，不受此值限制。

description.en: Per node. The defaults suit most deployments.
description.zh: 按节点计算，默认值适合大多数部署。

ui:help.en: Requests waiting for background moderation on each node.
ui:help.zh: 每个节点等待后台审核的请求数上限。

ui:details.en: When the queue is full, new requests are not moderated and are counted as dropped.
ui:details.zh: 队列满了之后新请求不再审核，并计入丢弃数。

ui:help.en: An upstream call that has not answered (headers, or the first model output of a stream) in this time fails with ttft_timeout. A non-streaming LLM call gets its answer all at once, so only the channel timeout applies to it.
ui:help.zh: 上游调用在这段时间内没有响应（收到响应头，流式调用为第一个模型输出）就按 ttft_timeout 失败。非流式的 LLM 调用一次性收到全部回答，只受渠道超时限制。

ui:details.en: Applies to the OpenAI moderation and Jev auditor calls, together with the channel's total timeout; whichever fires first ends the call. LLM verdict auditors are not streamed and only have the channel timeout.
ui:details.zh: 对 OpenAI 审核和 Jev 审核器的调用生效，与渠道的总超时同时计时，先到者结束调用。LLM 判定审核器不走流式，只受渠道超时限制。

ui:help.zh: 同一流程下已经审过的内容，结论保留这么多天：放行的不再送审，命中的直接按原结论处理（先审的请求被拒绝），不再调用审核渠道。0 = 关闭判定缓存。
ui:help.en: Verdicts on content already moderated under the same flow are kept this many days: content that passed is not sent again, and a hit is applied again as it was (a request moderated first is refused) without calling the moderation channels. 0 turns the verdict cache off.

ui:details.en: Runs with errors, passes with a skipped stage and URL images are not cached. Changing a flow's stages, auditors, question sets, thresholds or channel models invalidates that flow's cache. A replayed cached hit is recorded as usual but is not a new violation.
ui:details.zh: 出错的运行、整级被跳过的放行、URL 图片不缓存。修改流程的级、审核器、题集、阈值或渠道模型后，该流程的缓存自动失效。缓存命中的重放照常写记录，但不算新的违规。

ui:enumNames.en: Replay the hit, moderate new content
ui:enumNames.zh: 只重放命中部分，新内容照常审核

ui:enumNames.en: Treat the whole request as a hit

ui:help.en: When a request still holds content that hit, such as the history of a conversation: the recommended choice replays only that part and moderates what is new in the background; the old behaviour treats the whole request as a hit and moderates nothing new. A request checked first is refused either way; with the recommended choice the message asks the user to clear the conversation.
ui:help.zh: 请求里仍含有已命中的内容（例如对话历史）时：推荐只把那部分按原结论处理，其余新内容在后台照常送审；旧行为是整个请求直接按命中处理，新内容不再送审。先审的请求两种方式都会被拒绝，推荐方式的提示会请用户清理上下文。

ui:help.en: How many cached verdicts (passes and hits) each node keeps in memory; the shared store holds them all for the days above.
ui:help.zh: 每个节点在内存里保留多少条判定缓存（放行和命中都算）；共享存储按上面的天数保留全部。

ui:help.en: Everything the client sends (messages of every role, system prompt, tool calls and results, documents) is moderated. Whitespace is collapsed and longer content is moderated in chunks of this length.
ui:help.zh: 客户端发送的全部内容（各角色的消息、系统提示词、工具调用与结果、文档）都会审核。压缩空白后，超过这个长度的内容按这个长度分块审核。

ui:title.zh: 每个请求最多审核块数

ui:help.en: Content with a cached verdict is not sent again (verdict cache: passes and hits, kept per flow for as long as its judging configuration - stages, auditors, question sets, thresholds, channel models - stays the same); only the rest is chunked. Each chunk is one run of the flow, with its own upstream calls.
ui:help.zh: 已有缓存结论的内容不会再次送审（判定缓存：放行和命中都缓存，按流程保存，流程的判定配置——级、审核器、题集、阈值、渠道模型——不变就一直有效），只有其余内容参与分块。每块各执行一次流程，各自产生上游调用。

ui:help.en: Sample: the first, the last and evenly spread chunks are moderated. Refuse: requests moderated before the upstream call are refused (background moderation still samples).
ui:help.zh: 抽样审核：审核第一块、最后一块和均匀分布的中间块。直接拒绝：先审后发的请求直接拒绝（后台审核仍按抽样）。

ui:title.zh: 每个请求最多审核图片数

ui:help.en: Images beyond this number (or larger than 16 MiB) are not moderated; 0 moderates no images.
ui:help.zh: 超过这个数量（或大于 16 MiB）的图片不审核；0 表示不审核图片。

ui:help.en: When the hook requests being processed hold more than this, new requests are answered at once. Requests that would be moderated before they are sent on get 503 moderation_busy: with mode enforce that is every user who is neither on the allowlist nor on the watch list at the observe level, with mode observe only blocklisted users and enforce-level watch entries. All other requests pass unmoderated. Requests no flow moderates (no flow for the group, or a model the flow's filter leaves out) are never refused.
ui:help.zh: 正在处理的钩子请求合计超过这个大小时，新请求立即返回。本应先审后放的请求返回 503 moderation_busy：模式为拦截时，是白名单和观察级名单之外的所有用户；模式为观察时，只有黑名单用户和拦截级名单用户。其余请求不审核直接放行。没有流程会审核的请求（分组没有流程，或模型被流程的模型过滤排除）不会被拒绝。

ui:help.en: Error records (a channel failed) keep only the start of the moderated text; 0 keeps none.
ui:help.zh: 出错记录（渠道故障等）只保存被审核文本的开头这么多字；0 表示不保存。

ui:help.en: Text shorter than this (ignoring whitespace) and without images is not moderated.
ui:help.zh: 去掉空白后短于该字数且没有图片的输入不审核。

description.en: How much of a request is sent to the auditors.
description.zh: 每个请求送审的字数、块数和图片数上限。

ui:help.en: Used by Jev auditors without their own table. Empty = the built-in Chinese set.
ui:help.zh: 没有自己题集的 Jev 审核器使用它。留空使用内置中文题集。

description.en: Used by the Jev and question auditors that have no questions of their own.
description.zh: 没有自定义题目的 Jev 和问答型审核器使用这里的题集。

ui:help.en: A key of the 0.1 single-model setup that is still stored. Nothing reads it any more; it is declared only so that it stays masked. Saving the settings drops it.
ui:help.zh: 0.1 单模型设置里仍保存着的密钥。已不再读取，声明它只是为了继续遮蔽显示。保存一次设置即会删除它。

ui:help.en: A flow, auditor or channel whose last-hour error rate is above this (with at least 20 samples) is flagged in the overview, and a flow crossing it sends one notice. A stage that fails is passed over: a hit of an earlier stage stands, and the request passes only when no stage judged at all.
ui:help.zh: 近 1 小时异常率超过该值（且样本不少于 20）的流程、审核器、渠道在概览中标红；流程越过阈值时发一次通知。出错的级会被跳过：前面级的命中仍然有效，只有没有任何一级给出判定时请求才放行。

ui:help.en: Receives flow error-rate alerts. Empty: no notices.
ui:help.zh: 接收流程异常率告警。留空则不发送。

ui:help.en: When set, each notice carries X-Signature: sha256=HMAC(secret, body).
ui:help.zh: 填写后每条通知带 X-Signature: sha256=HMAC(密钥, 请求体)。

ui:help.en: Hourly statistics, per-user daily counts and moderation costs older than this are deleted by the daily cleanup.
ui:help.zh: 每日清理时删除超过该天数的小时统计、用户每日计数和审核费用。
